parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Two capacitors *X* and *Y* are connected in series to a power supply of voltage *V*, as shown in Fig. 6.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The capacitance of *X* is *C*ₓ and the capacitance of *Y* is *C*ᵧ.

Derive an expression, in terms of *C*ₓ and *C*ᵧ, for the combined capacitance *C*ₜ of the capacitors in this circuit. Explain your reasoning.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: Two capacitors *P* and *Q* are connected in parallel to a power supply of voltage *V*. The capacitance of *P* is 200 μF. The capacitance *C*Q of *Q* can be varied between 0 and 400 μF. When *C*Q = 0, the total energy stored in the capacitors is 2.5 mJ.
parts.text: Show that the supply voltage *V* is 5.0 V.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the total energy, in mJ, stored in the capacitors when *C*Q has its maximum value.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
On Fig. 6.2, sketch the variation of the total energy *E* stored in the capacitors with *C*Q as *C*Q varies from 0 to 400 μF.

[[fig:f2]]
